record.field: Triage, hazmat, recycler transfer, disposal certificates, DoE returns and e-waste money (M18).
Records the write-once triage decision (reuse / refurbish / recycle / hazardous) as a named assessor (BRU-ESG-09, T-04). Needs an employee record.
Records the UN 3480 battery inspection with photo evidence: terminals taped, swollen cells quarantined (BRU-ESG-07/08).
Builds, dispatches, receives and processes recycler batches and records the recycler's certificate. Never dispatches to a recycler they approved (spec §13).
Procurement / Quality Manager: approves a recycler's registration from the M63 inbox (never their own), suspends it, and is warned of licence expiry.
Quality Manager / ESG owner: prepares and submits DoE/BTRC returns, issues and revokes disposal certificates, records Basel consents, DoE registrations and storage extensions.
CFO: records the authority's acceptance of a return it did not prepare, and approves incentives, recycler fees and recovery income from the M63 inbox.
